The idea

More than a beautiful blowout.

Your clients already tell you everything. The hot flashes. The sleepless nights. The weight that will not move. The hair that is not as full as it was.

“I have not slept in weeks.”“Is my hair thinner?”“Nothing I do works anymore.”

You are often the first person to notice thinning at the part, sometimes before she does. Salon Care gives that moment somewhere to go: a free consult with a Las Vegas physician who can look at the whole picture.

✓

You introduce. Vitality takes it from there. Our medical team handles evaluation, labs, treatment and follow up. Stylists never diagnose, recommend medication or handle health information.

Circle of care

Five kinds of care.
One place to start.

Most women juggle a gynecologist, a dermatologist, a gym and a primary doctor who never talk to each other. At Vitality, the circles overlap. One physician led team, one plan, and it starts with a free consult.

Weight care

Physician led GLP-1 care with semaglutide or tirzepatide when clinically appropriate, plus nutrition and coaching that protect muscle.

Hair restoration

A medical look at thinning hair, including thyroid, iron and hormones. Minoxidil, finasteride or other options may be considered after review.

Hormone care

Perimenopause and menopause care, including hormone therapy when it is right for you, for hot flashes, sleep, mood and libido.

Primary care

A physician who knows your whole story, with labs, prevention and follow up. Credentialed with Medicare, Medicaid, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, CareSource and Humana for eligible services, with more plans on the way.

Fitness

InBody 570 body composition scans and guidance from a NASM certified fitness instructor in our clinic gym.

The conversation she is already having

Perimenopause is real.
So is the help.

Perimenopause can start in the early 40s and last for years. It can bring hot flashes, broken sleep, brain fog, mood changes, thinning hair and midlife weight gain. Many women are told to push through it.

Hot flashesNight sweatsPoor sleepThinning hairStubborn weightLow libidoBrain fog

In November 2025 the FDA announced it would remove the long standing boxed warnings from menopausal hormone therapy labels, and more women are asking about treatment. Vitality offers a physician evaluation and, when it is appropriate for her, hormone therapy, hair treatment and weight care in one plan.

Treatment depends on a medical evaluation and is not right for everyone.

Partnership economics

10 members.
$7,200 a year potential.

A simple illustration of what one salon could earn. Your display payment is fixed. Client credits grow with every member who stays active, and they are spent with you.

Display placement$100

Per month for keeping Vitality materials in your salon. That is $1,200 a year.

Client credit$50

Salon credit every month for each active member, spent in your salon. Ten members is $6,000 a year.

Annual potential$7,200

Ten active members plus your display, for twelve months.

Illustration only. This is revenue, not profit, and it assumes ten members stay active and paid for the full year. Final terms, eligibility and payment schedules will be provided in a written agreement after healthcare legal review.

How the program works

Clear terms.
No guesswork.

Client credit

$50 salon credit every month

Every active Salon Care member gets a $50 credit to spend in your salon each month, once per member per month. A medical visit alone does not create a credit.

Display payment

$100 a month for your display

Paid for keeping Vitality display materials in your salon, whether or not anyone signs up.

Your role

You introduce, we handle care

Stylists never diagnose, prescribe or handle health information. Vitality’s physicians take it from there.

Your link

A personal QR code

Every salon, and every suite stylist, gets a unique QR code so the clients you send are credited to you. A private partner view is planned.

Made for salons

Beautiful in your space.
Easy for her to act on.

Salons are not barbershops. Many stylists work from their own suite, so we fit the display to the space you actually have.

Mirror cling

A small, elegant decal at the station, right where the conversation happens.

Counter card

A tabletop card with your QR code for the front desk or your suite.

Lobby banner

A 6 by 2 foot retractable banner for salons with a waiting area.

Client cards

Pocket cards stylists can hand over quietly, with the free consult offer.

What to say in the chair

Natural. Kind.
Never a pitch.

We will train you in a short session at the clinic. Here is the idea.

“I noticed a little thinning at your part. That is really common in our 40s, and sometimes it is hormones or thyroid. I work with a doctor who checks for that, and the first consult is free. Want the card?”
  • Share what you noticed and hand over the card or QR code.
  • Let Vitality answer every medical question.
  • Never diagnose, suggest a medication or ask about her health history.
  • Never collect or write down a client’s health information.
